entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, and my agent ID is 302. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. I need to return it, but I'm a bit outside the normal window and was hoping we could work something out.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you please tell me what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh no, it works fine. The problem is timing. My husband was supposed to take it on his military deployment, but there was a last-minute emergency. He ended up in the hospital for an unexpected surgery and his deployment was postponed. I've been with him this whole time and completely missed the return window.
I'm very sorry to hear about your husband's emergency. I hope he's recovering well. Let me pull up your order and check the return eligibility. Do you have your order number handy?

Yes, it's VF-8675309. Look, I know policy is policy, but given the circumstances, I was hoping for maybe a partial store credit? Or even a discount code for a future purchase? I understand a full refund might be too much to ask now.
Thank you. I have your order here, received 32 days ago. One moment while I review our internal policy... Okay, I'm checking the knowledge base now.

Actually, I have good news. It looks like you don't need any special exception. Our policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 32, you're well within the timeframe.
Oh! Really? Ninety days? I thought I read online it was much shorter for electronics.

The system here says 90 days, so we'll honor that. I've just initiated the return process for you and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file. You'll receive a full refund once we receive the item.
Wow, that's fantastic. That's so much easier than I expected. Thank you so much, Alex. That's a huge relief after everything with the hospital and the surgery.
You're very welcome. We're happy to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. You've been a great help. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
